verdict.rationale: Brex documents multi-entity and multi-currency operation: a legal_entity_id dimension in its Team API, budgets and spend limits in over 100 currencies with localized policies for entities, and local-account payments that avoid intercompany transactions. Nothing in the evidence describes consolidated cross-entity reporting or separate per-entity ledgers. missing for 10: documented consolidated reporting across entities, per-entity books/ledger mapping, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-entity close

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run multiple legal entities and currencies in one account with consolidated reporting and per-entity books

citations.quote: Manage budgets and spend limits in over 100 currencies and embed localized expense policies to enable spend for entities, individuals, and departments.
Pay your global statements and reimbursements to and from local bank accounts to avoid intercompany transactions and accelerate payments.
Manage global spend and close the books in real time
